mods.abstract: Made by Davol Rubber Company, Providence, Rhode Island. One 9-inch English Ice Bag, with improved screw cap. Number 439. Bag has engraved: Patented June 1918, March [illegible]. Screw cap has engraved: Pat Aug 1927, Other Pat Pend.
